triggerReasons.message: Request has a structural multi-deliverable signal, so milestone coverage must be countable.
A milestone ledger exists, so every ledger row needs checklist and verificationIntent coverage.
High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: A B-19ca regression runs the command plan once, records commandExecution PASS with stale coverage, refreshes only verificationEvidence, then the next validation reports disposition=reused and commandExecutions=0 with no evidence or HEAD write.
acceptanceBindings.note: Single user outcome composed from command-execution identity/reuse, current coverage, audit/no-write behavior, regression proof and canonical documentation.

diagnosticGaps.message: Red evidence is triggered but no current red evidence record binds baseline head/material to the correct acceptance target and green relation.

Milestone ledger has 6 row(s), above the 5 row threshold for high_assurance. Record a complete slice-plan.json or assignedStory fields before enforce-mode DEV admission; suggested slicing groups are diagnostic only and no child stories are created automatically.

note: Routine validation reuse never waives current coverage; all six implementation/documentation milestones bind to one observable zero-command reuse acceptance claim.
